#### Setup

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Locate project root: env var → knitr root.dir → config.yaml walk-up → cwd
find_project_root <- function() {
  env_root <- Sys.getenv("CFMD_BENCH_WORKDIR", unset = "")
  if (nzchar(env_root) && dir.exists(env_root)) return(normalizePath(env_root))

  knitr_root <- tryCatch(
    normalizePath(knitr::opts_knit$get("root.dir"), mustWork = FALSE),
    error = function(e) ""
  )
  if (nzchar(knitr_root) && dir.exists(knitr_root)) return(knitr_root)

  start <- tryCatch(
    dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), mustWork = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) getwd()
  )
  d <- start
  for (i in seq_len(10L)) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(d, "config.yaml"))) return(d)
    parent <- dirname(d)
    if (parent == d) break
    d <- parent
  }
  getwd()
}

root <- find_project_root()
setwd(root)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

#### Import Data

```{r import, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tab_raw <- cfmdbench_load_data(
  repo                   = cfg$data_source$repo,
  data_path              = cfg$data_source$path,
  ref                    = ver,
  cache_dir              = cache_dir,
  manifest_path          = manifest_path,
  completeness_threshold = completeness_threshold,
  batch_size             = api_batch_size
)

# Plot samples whose taxa sum deviates from 100
sample_cols     <- grep("^k__", names(tab_raw), value = TRUE)
taxa_wide       <- tab_raw[, sample_cols]
col_sums_all    <- colSums(
  suppressWarnings(apply(taxa_wide, 2L, as.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)
bad_samples     <- names(col_sums_all)[abs(col_sums_all - 100) > 1e-3]

if (length(bad_samples)) {
  bad_df <- data.frame(
    sample  = bad_samples,
    Sum     = as.numeric(col_sums_all[bad_samples]),
    Project = sapply(strsplit(bad_samples, "__"), `[`, 1L)
  )
  p <- ggplot(bad_df, aes(x = Sum, y = reorder(sample, Sum),
                           text = paste("Project:", Project))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    facet_wrap(~ Project, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Sum", y = "Sample") +
    theme_minimal()
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
} else {
  message("All samples pass the completeness check (sum ~ 100).")
}
```

#### Pre-Process I

```{r preprocess1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Convert to correct types and keep sample + target + microbial features
tab <- tab_raw %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("k__"), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    !!as.symbol(target) := factor(
      !!as.symbol(target),
      levels = sort(unique(!!as.symbol(target)))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(sample, !!as.symbol(target), starts_with("k__"))

names(tab)[names(tab) == target] <- "target"

# Filter classes by minimum sample size
tab <- tab %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  mutate(n = n()) %>%
  filter(n >= min_samples_per_class) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = samples_to_keep) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  droplevels()

# Determine classification type and metrics
positive_class <- ""
if (length(levels(tab$target)) > 2L) {
  dataset_attr  <- "multi-class"
  bmr_measures  <- c("classif.acc", "classif.bacc", "classif.logloss")
  train_measures <- c("classif.bacc", "classif.logloss")
} else if (length(levels(tab$target)) == 2L) {
  dataset_attr  <- "binary"
  bmr_measures  <- c("classif.acc", "classif.bacc", "classif.logloss",
                     "classif.precision", "classif.recall", "classif.specificity",
                     "classif.fbeta", "classif.auc", "classif.prauc")
  train_measures <- c("classif.bacc", "classif.logloss")
  if (!nzchar(positive_class)) {
    positive_class <- names(which.min(table(tab$target)))
  }
} else {
  stop("Target column has < 2 classes — check the data or the target setting.")
}

cat("\nClassification type:", dataset_attr, "\n")
cat("Evaluation metrics: ", paste(train_measures, collapse = ", "), "\n")

tab %<>% rename_with(~ gsub("\\|", "_", .))
tab %<>% sample_frac(size = 1)
```

#### Visualize Data II

```{r visualize2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
.make_ordination_df <- function(tab_in, downsample_n, prevalence_min) {
  df        <- as_tibble(tab_in) %>% mutate(target = str_replace_all(target, "_", " "))
  taxa_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("target", "sample"))

  shorten_one <- function(n) {
    if (grepl("s__", n)) return(sub(".*(s__.*)$", "\\1", n))
    if (grepl("g__", n)) return(sub(".*(g__.*)$", "\\1", n))
    n
  }
  new_names <- make.unique(vapply(taxa_cols, shorten_one, character(1L)), sep = "_")
  names(df)[match(taxa_cols, names(df))] <- new_names

  y <- df$target
  X <- df[, !(names(df) %in% c("target", "sample")), drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(X) > downsample_n) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(X)), downsample_n)
    X <- X[idx, , drop = FALSE]; y <- y[idx]
  }

  prev <- colMeans(X > 0)
  X    <- X[, prev >= prevalence_min,    drop = FALSE]
  X    <- X[, apply(X, 2L, var) > 0,    drop = FALSE]
  if (!ncol(X)) stop("All features filtered; lower prevalence_min.")

  X0    <- zCompositions::cmultRepl(as.matrix(X), label = 0, method = "CZM",
                                    z.warning = 1, z.delete = FALSE)
  X_clr <- compositions::clr(X0)
  list(X = X, X_clr = X_clr, y = y)
}

ord <- .make_ordination_df(tab, downsample_n, prevalence_min)

# PCA
pca    <- prcomp(ord$X_clr, scale. = TRUE)
scores <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[, 1L], PC2 = pca$x[, 2L], target = ord$y)

fviz_eig(pca, addlabels = TRUE)

ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, fill = target)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 5, colour = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "PCA on CLR-transformed abundances",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2L, 1L], 1L), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2L, 2L], 1L), "%)"))

fviz_contrib(pca, choice = "var", axes = 1:2, top = 10L)

# Elbow plot
cum_var      <- cumsum(pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2))
n_comp_90    <- which(cum_var >= 0.9)[1L]
cat("Components explaining 90% variance:", n_comp_90, "\n")

ggplot(data.frame(k = seq_along(cum_var), v = cum_var), aes(k, v)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = n_comp_90, color = "dodgerblue3", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(cum_var)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Elbow plot of PCA components",
       subtitle = "Reference line: 90% variance threshold",
       x = "Number of components", y = "Cumulative proportion of variance")

# t-SNE
perplexity <- pmin(30L, floor((nrow(ord$X_clr) - 1L) / 3L))
ts <- Rtsne::Rtsne(ord$X_clr, pca = TRUE, check_duplicates = FALSE,
                   perplexity = perplexity, theta = 0.5, num_threads = 8L)
ts_df <- data.frame(tSNE1 = ts$Y[, 1L], tSNE2 = ts$Y[, 2L], target = ord$y)

ggplot(ts_df, aes(tSNE1, tSNE2, fill = target)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 5, colour = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "t-SNE on CLR-transformed abundances") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18), legend.text = element_text(size = 12))
```

#### Define Task

```{r task, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tab$sample <- trimws(as.character(tab$sample))
stopifnot("sample" %in% names(tab), "target" %in% names(tab))

if (anyDuplicated(tab$sample)) {
  dups <- tab$sample[duplicated(tab$sample)]
  message("Duplicated sample IDs: ", length(dups))
  tab$sample_id <- make.unique(tab$sample)
  id_col <- "sample_id"
} else {
  id_col <- "sample"
}

backend  <- mlr3::as_data_backend(tab, primary_key = seq_len(nrow(tab)))
task     <- mlr3::as_task_classif(backend, target = "target")
task$set_col_roles("sample", roles = character())

split      <- mlr3::partition(task, ratio = 0.8)
task_train <- task$clone(deep = TRUE)$filter(split$train)
task_test  <- task$clone(deep = TRUE)$filter(split$test)

if (dataset_attr == "binary") {
  task$positive       <- positive_class
  task_train$positive <- positive_class
  task_test$positive  <- positive_class
}

task$set_col_roles("target",       c("target", "stratum"))
task_train$set_col_roles("target", c("target", "stratum"))
task_test$set_col_roles("target",  c("target", "stratum"))
```

#### Pre-Process II

```{r preprocess2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Class distribution
class_counts    <- table(task_train$data()$target)
majority_class  <- names(which.max(class_counts))
minority_class  <- names(which.min(class_counts))
imbalance_ratio <- class_counts[majority_class] / class_counts[minority_class]

cat("\nClass distribution:\n"); print(class_counts)
cat("Imbalance ratio:", round(imbalance_ratio, 2L), ":1\n")

class_counts_df <- as.data.frame(class_counts)
colnames(class_counts_df) <- c("target", "count")

ggplot(class_counts_df, aes(x = reorder(target, count, decreasing = TRUE),
                              y = count, fill = target)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Class Distribution", x = "Target Class", y = "Count") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# SMOTE decision
imbalance_threshold <- 1.5
apply_smote <- imbalance_ratio > imbalance_threshold &&
               all(class_counts >= min_samples_per_class)

if (!nzchar(smote)) smote <- if (apply_smote) "smote" else "none"
if (!apply_smote)   smote <- "none"
cat("SMOTE decision:", smote, "\n")

# Build preprocessing pipeline
if (selecting) filtering <- "minimal"

preprocessing_pipe <- if (filtering == "varcor") {
  mlr3pipelines::ppl("robustify") %>>%
    mlr3pipelines::po("filter", filter = mlr3filters::flt("variance"),
                      id = "variance_filter") %>>%
    mlr3pipelines::po("filter", filter = mlr3filters::flt("find_correlation"),
                      method = "spearman", id = "correlation_filter") %>>%
    mlr3pipelines::po("colapply", applicator = as.numeric,
                      affect_columns = mlr3pipelines::selector_type(
                        c("integer", "logical", "numeric")))
} else if (filtering %in% c(TRUE, "minimal") || selecting) {
  mlr3pipelines::ppl("robustify") %>>%
    mlr3pipelines::po("colapply", applicator = as.numeric,
                      affect_columns = mlr3pipelines::selector_type(
                        c("integer", "logical", "numeric")))
} else if (filtering == "infogain") {
  mlr3pipelines::ppl("robustify") %>>%
    mlr3pipelines::po("filter", filter = mlr3filters::flt("information_gain"),
                      id = "infogain_filter") %>>%
    mlr3pipelines::po("colapply", applicator = as.numeric,
                      affect_columns = mlr3pipelines::selector_type(
                        c("integer", "logical", "numeric")))
} else {
  mlr3pipelines::po("nop")
}

if (!isFALSE(filtering)) {
  preprocessing_pipe <- preprocessing_pipe %>>% mlr3pipelines::po("scale", center = TRUE)
}

smote_pipe <- NULL
if (apply_smote && smote %in% c("smote", "blsmote", "adasyn")) {
  smote_pipe <- switch(smote,
    smote   = mlr3pipelines::po("smote"),
    blsmote = mlr3pipelines::po("blsmote"),
    adasyn  = mlr3pipelines::po("adas"),
    NULL
  )
}
if (!is.null(smote_pipe)) {
  preprocessing_pipe <- preprocessing_pipe %>>% smote_pipe
}

# Remove lazy_tensor from all PipeOps (mlr3torch safety)
for (po_name in names(preprocessing_pipe$pipeops)) {
  po_obj <- preprocessing_pipe$pipeops[[po_name]]
  priv   <- po_obj$.__enclos_env__$private
  if (!is.null(priv$.feature_types) && "lt" %in% names(priv$.feature_types)) {
    cat("Removing 'lazy_tensor' from:", po_name, "\n")
    priv$.feature_types <- priv$.feature_types[names(priv$.feature_types) != "lt"]
  }
}

cat("\nFinal preprocessing pipeline:\n"); print(preprocessing_pipe)

# Preprocessing search space parameters
preproc_params <- list()
if (filtering == "varcor") {
  preproc_params <- c(preproc_params, list(
    variance_filter.filter.frac    = paradox::p_dbl(0.5, 1, logscale = TRUE),
    correlation_filter.filter.frac = paradox::p_dbl(0.5, 1, logscale = TRUE)
  ))
} else if (filtering == "infogain") {
  preproc_params <- c(preproc_params, list(
    infogain_filter.filter.frac = paradox::p_dbl(0.2, 1.0, logscale = TRUE)
  ))
}
if (!is.null(smote_pipe)) {
  preproc_params <- c(preproc_params, switch(smote,
    smote   = list(smote.K = paradox::p_int(2L, 5L),
                   smote.dup_size = paradox::p_int(1L, 5L)),
    blsmote = list(blsmote.K = paradox::p_int(2L, 5L),
                   blsmote.dup_size = paradox::p_int(1L, 5L),
                   blsmote.C = paradox::p_int(1L, 5L)),
    adasyn  = list(adas.K = paradox::p_int(2L, 5L)),
    list()
  ))
}
```

#### Feature Selection

```{r feature_selection, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
future::plan(future::sequential)
future::plan(future::multisession, workers = num_jobs)

num_col <- cfg$feature_selection$num_col
num_row <- cfg$feature_selection$num_row

if (selecting) {
  n_features <- if (task_train$ncol < num_col) 2L else 10L
  fs_method  <- if (task_train$nrow > num_row) "simple" else "ensemble"

  rfe       <- mlr3fselect::fs("rfe", n_features = n_features, feature_fraction = 0.8)
  svm_rfe   <- mlr3fselect::clbk("mlr3fselect.svm_rfe")
  one_se    <- mlr3fselect::clbk("mlr3fselect.one_se_rule")

  max_nrounds  <- 500L
  internal_ss  <- paradox::ps(nrounds = paradox::p_int(
    upper = max_nrounds,
    aggr  = function(x) as.integer(mean(unlist(x)))
  ))
  xgb_clbk <- mlr3fselect::clbk("mlr3fselect.internal_tuning",
                                  internal_search_space = internal_ss)

  fs_rpart   <- mlr3::lrn("classif.rpart")
  fs_ranger  <- mlr3::lrn("classif.ranger",  importance = "permutation")
  fs_svm     <- mlr3::lrn("classif.svm",     type = "C-classification", kernel = "linear")
  fs_xgboost <- mlr3::lrn("classif.xgboost", nrounds = max_nrounds,
                            early_stopping_rounds = 10L)
  mlr3::set_validate(fs_xgboost, 0.2)
  mlr3::set_threads(fs_ranger,  n = ceiling(num_threads / 5L))
  mlr3::set_threads(fs_xgboost, n = ceiling(num_threads / 5L))

  fs_rpart$id   <- "rpart"
  fs_ranger$id  <- "rf"
  fs_svm$id     <- "svm"
  fs_xgboost$id <- "xgboost"

  # Robustify tasks before FS
  robust_pipe <- mlr3pipelines::ppl("robustify") %>>%
    mlr3pipelines::po("colapply", applicator = as.numeric,
                      affect_columns = mlr3pipelines::selector_type(
                        c("integer", "logical", "numeric")))
  robust_pipe$train(task_train)
  task_train <- robust_pipe$predict(task_train)[[1L]]
  task_test  <- robust_pipe$predict(task_test)[[1L]]

  if (fs_method == "ensemble") {
    efs <- mlr3fselect::ensemble_fselect(
      fselector          = rfe,
      task               = task_train,
      learners           = list(fs_rpart, fs_ranger, fs_svm, fs_xgboost),
      init_resampling    = mlr3::rsmp("subsampling", repeats = 50L, ratio = 0.8),
      inner_resampling   = mlr3::rsmp("cv", folds = 5L),
      inner_measure      = mlr3::msr("classif.ce"),
      measure            = mlr3::msr("classif.bacc"),
      terminator         = mlr3tuning::trm("none"),
      callbacks          = list(
        rpart   = list(one_se),
        rf      = list(one_se),
        svm     = list(one_se, svm_rfe),
        xgboost = list(one_se, xgb_clbk)
      ),
      store_benchmark_result = FALSE
    )

    print(efs); head(efs$result)
    print(autoplot(efs, type = "performance",  theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)))
    print(autoplot(efs, type = "n_features",   theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)))
    print(autoplot(efs, type = "pareto",       theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)))
    print(autoplot(efs, type = "pareto", pareto_front = "estimated",
                   theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)) +
          scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") + labs(title = "Estimated Pareto front"))

    kp <- efs$knee_points(type = "estimated")
    n_feat <- if (is.na(kp$n_features)) {
      message("Estimated knee point NA — using median feature count.")
      median(efs$result$n_features, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      message("Estimated knee point: ", kp$n_features, " features.")
      kp$n_features
    }

    global_stab <- efs$stability("jaccard", global = TRUE)
    message("Global stability (Jaccard): ", global_stab)
    print(efs$stability("jaccard", global = FALSE))
    print(autoplot(efs, type = "stability", theme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14)) +
          scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1"))

    consensus_av  <- efs$feature_ranking(method = "av", committee_size = n_feat,
                                          use_weights = TRUE)
    selected_feats <- consensus_av$feature
    print(consensus_av)
  } else {
    fsi_obj <- mlr3fselect::fsi(
      task       = task_train,
      learner    = fs_ranger,
      resampling = mlr3::rsmp("cv", folds = 5L),
      measure    = mlr3::msr("classif.bacc"),
      terminator = mlr3tuning::trm("none")
    )
    rfe$optimize(fsi_obj)
    print(data.table::as.data.table(fsi_obj$result)[, .(features, classif.bacc)])
    selected_feats <- fsi_obj$result_feature_set
  }

  task_train$select(selected_feats)
  task_test$select(selected_feats)
}
```

#### Benchmark

```{r benchmark, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
measure <- c(accuracy = "classif.acc")

future::plan(future::sequential)
future::plan(future::multisession, workers = num_jobs)

# Load / prepare learners for benchmarking
min_count <- task_train$data() %>%
  dplyr::count(target) %>% dplyr::pull(n) %>% min()

benchmark_resampling <- if (min_count <= kfold) {
  mlr3::rsmp("bootstrap", repeats = 10L, ratio = 1)
} else {
  mlr3::rsmp("cv", folds = kfold)
}

learners_best <- cfmdbench_load_benchmark_learners(
  methods, trained_learners, save_dir, task_train)

# Preprocessing summaries
for (method in names(learners_best)) {
  summary <- suppressWarnings(
    cfmdbench_get_preproc_summary(learners_best[[method]],
                                   after = if (apply_smote) smote else "scale"))
  if (!is.null(summary)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n--- [%s] ---\n", method))
    if (!is.na(summary$n_features)) {
      cat(sprintf("Final features (%d):\n", summary$n_features))
      print(summary$features)
      cat("Class distribution:\n"); print(summary$class_distribution)
    } else {
      cat("No Task output; see filter summary above.\n")
    }
  }
}

# Run benchmark
start_bmr <- Sys.time()
cat("Benchmark start:", format(start_bmr, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
bmr <- mlr3::benchmark(
  design = mlr3::benchmark_grid(task_train, learners_best, benchmark_resampling))
cat("Benchmark done: ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n")
cat("Time:", round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_bmr, units = "mins")), 2),
    "minutes\n")

# Autoplot
autoplot(bmr, measure = mlr3::msr(measure[[1L]])) +
  labs(x = "Method", y = paste(names(measure[1L]), "measure")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = as.character(unlist(methods))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title  = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title  = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5))

# Summary table
bench_df <- cfmdbench_format_bench_df(bmr, bmr_measures)
print(bench_df %>% select(-learner_id))

# Dodged barplot
bench_long <- bench_df %>%
  select(method, accuracy, `balanced accuracy`, logloss) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(accuracy, `balanced accuracy`, logloss),
               names_to = "measure", values_to = "value")

metric_colors <- c(accuracy = "skyblue3", `balanced accuracy` = "dodgerblue3",
                   logloss = "tomato3")

ggplot(bench_long, aes(x = method, y = value, fill = measure)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = metric_colors) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 2L)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), vjust = 1.5,
            color = "white", size = 3L) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Model performance measures", x = "Method", y = "Value") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title  = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title  = element_text(size = 18))

# Best model
best_row      <- bench_df %>% arrange(desc(`balanced accuracy`), logloss) %>% slice(1L)
best_model_id <- best_row$learner_id
best_method   <- best_row$method

# Average fold-wise predictions for best model
pred_dt    <- data.table::as.data.table(bmr$score())
best_preds <- pred_dt[stringr::str_detect(learner_id, best_model_id)]
all_preds  <- best_preds$prediction_test %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(~ data.table::as.data.table(.x) %>% tibble::as_tibble())
prob_cols  <- grep("^prob\\.", names(all_preds), value = TRUE)

if (length(prob_cols) == 2L) {
  positive_col <- paste0("prob.", positive_class)
  avg_preds <- all_preds %>%
    group_by(row_ids) %>%
    summarise(prob_positive = mean(.data[[positive_col]]),
              truth = first(truth), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      response = if_else(prob_positive >= 0.5, positive_class,
                         setdiff(levels(truth), positive_class)),
      response = factor(response, levels = levels(truth)),
      correct  = response == truth
    )
} else {
  avg_preds <- all_preds %>%
    group_by(row_ids) %>%
    summarise(
      response = names(which.max(colMeans(across(all_of(prob_cols))))),
      truth = first(truth), .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(response = sub("prob\\.", "", response),
           response = factor(response, levels = levels(truth)),
           correct  = response == truth)
}

pred_summary <- avg_preds %>%
  group_by(truth, correct) %>%
  summarise(N = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(truth) %>%
  mutate(prop = N / sum(N)) %>%
  ungroup()

p1 <- ggplot(pred_summary, aes(x = truth, y = N, fill = correct, label = N)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  geom_text(position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "dodgerblue3", "FALSE" = "red3")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Absolute Counts", x = "True Class", y = "Count", fill = "Correct") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p2 <- ggplot(pred_summary,
             aes(x = truth, y = prop, fill = correct,
                 label = sprintf("%.0f%%", prop * 100))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  geom_text(position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "dodgerblue3", "FALSE" = "red3")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Proportion Correct", x = "True Class", y = "Proportion", fill = "Correct") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p3 <- ggplot(avg_preds, aes(x = truth, y = response, color = correct)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.4, width = 0.25, height = 0.25) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "dodgerblue3", "FALSE" = "red3")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "True vs Predicted", x = "True Class", y = "Predicted", color = "Correct") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1))

(p1 + p2 + p3) + plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = paste("Prediction Overview —", best_method),
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold",
                                                          hjust = 0.5)))
```

#### Prediction

```{r prediction, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
predictions <- list()

for (method in names(methods)) {
  best_model <- learners_best[[method]]

  if (is.null(best_model)) {
    path <- file.path(save_dir, paste0(method, "_tuned_learner.rds"))
    if (!file.exists(path)) {
      cat("SKIP:", method, "— no tuned learner found.\n"); next
    }
    best_model <- readRDS(path)
    try(best_model$unmarshal(), silent = TRUE)
    best_model$train(task_train)
  }

  pred              <- best_model$predict(task_test)
  predictions[[method]] <- pred
  sc                <- pred$score(mlr3::msr("classif.acc"))
  cat("\nclassif.acc of", methods[[method]], ":", round(sc, 2L), "\n")

  pred_tab       <- data.frame(truth = pred$truth, response = pred$response, pred$prob)
  pred_tab$match <- ifelse(pred_tab$truth == pred_tab$response, "TRUE", "FALSE")
  print(pred_tab %>% count(match) %>% mutate(ratio = round(n / sum(n), 2L)))

  assign(paste(method, "test", "predict", sep = "_"), pred_tab)
  assign(paste(method, "pred", "df",      sep = "_"),
         pred$score(measures = lapply(bmr_measures, mlr3::msr)))
}

pred_df <- cfmdbench_gather_pred_performance(env = environment(), bench_df = bench_df)
print(pred_df)

pred_tabs <- cfmdbench_gather_pred_tabs(env = environment())
plot_df   <- pred_tabs %>%
  mutate(truth = factor(truth, levels = task_test$class_names),
         match = factor(match, levels = c("TRUE", "FALSE"))) %>%
  count(method, truth, match, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(method, truth) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n), label = paste0(round(pct, 1L), "%")) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = truth, y = pct, fill = match)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", size = 3L) +
  facet_grid(method ~ ., scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "dodgerblue3", "FALSE" = "red3"),
                    name = "Correct") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1L),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Class", y = "Percent of predictions",
       title = "Test predictions by class and method") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18))
```

#### Feature Importance

```{r importance, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
method <- best_model_id

parse_taxon_name <- function(name) {
  parsed <- stringr::str_extract(name, "(?<=_s__).*")
  stringr::str_replace_all(parsed, "_t__", "_")
}

temp_dat  <- task_train$data()
temp_tab  <- temp_dat %>% dplyr::select(-target) %>% as.data.frame()
temp_targ <- temp_dat$target

original_names   <- colnames(temp_tab)
simplified_names <- vapply(original_names, parse_taxon_name, FUN.VALUE = character(1L))
name_mapping     <- setNames(simplified_names, original_names)

imodel    <- get(paste(method, "tuned", "learner", sep = "_"),
                 envir = .GlobalEnv)

temp_pred <- iml::Predictor$new(model = imodel, data = temp_tab,
                                 y = temp_targ, type = "prob")

future::plan(future::sequential)
if (!method %in% c("mlp", "tabpfn"))
  future::plan(future::multisession, workers = num_threads)

n_samp <- min(shap_n_samples, nrow(temp_tab))
idx    <- sample.int(nrow(temp_tab), n_samp)
temp_small <- temp_tab[idx, , drop = FALSE]

shap_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(temp_small)), function(i) {
  s <- iml::Shapley$new(temp_pred, x.interest = temp_small[i, , drop = FALSE])
  dplyr::mutate(s$results, sample_id = idx[i])
})
shap_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(shap_list)

shap_agg <- shap_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_abs_phi = mean(abs(phi)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(feature_pretty = dplyr::recode(feature, !!!name_mapping)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_abs_phi)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = shap_n_features)

ggplot(shap_agg, aes(x = reorder(feature_pretty, mean_abs_phi), y = mean_abs_phi)) +
  geom_col(fill = "royalblue3") + coord_flip() +
  labs(title = paste("Top", shap_n_features, "features by mean SHAP"),
       subtitle = paste(n_samp, "samples used"),
       x = "Feature (taxon)", y = "Mean |SHAP|") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18))

class_contrib <- shap_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature, class) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_phi = mean(phi), mean_abs_phi = mean(abs(phi)),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(feature_pretty = dplyr::recode(feature, !!!name_mapping),
                class = stringr::str_replace_all(class, "_", " ")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(feature %in% shap_agg$feature)

classes <- sort(unique(class_contrib$class))

if (length(classes) == 2L) {
  ref <- classes[1L]
  ggplot(class_contrib %>% dplyr::filter(class == ref),
         aes(x = reorder(feature_pretty, mean_phi), y = mean_phi,
             fill = mean_phi > 0)) +
    geom_col() + coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#1f78b4", "FALSE" = "#e31a1c"),
                      labels = c("Decreases P(ref)", "Increases P(ref)")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = paste("Class-specific SHAP (reference:", ref, ")"),
         subtitle = paste(n_samp, "samples,", shap_n_features, "features"),
         x = "Feature", y = paste("Mean SHAP for", ref), fill = "Effect") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 18))
} else {
  ggplot(class_contrib, aes(x = reorder(feature_pretty, mean_abs_phi),
                             y = mean_phi, fill = class)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") + coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Class-specific SHAP contributions",
         subtitle = paste(n_samp, "samples,", shap_n_features, "features"),
         x = "Feature (taxon)", y = "Mean SHAP value", fill = "Class") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 18))
}
```
